lessons.claim: A pre-registered tolerance is only a gate if tol/sigma > 3, and that has to be computed by running the REAL estimator on synthetic data from the matching hypothesis. Measured: 2 of 3 sealed gates had a tolerance inside their own 1 sigma, the worst at 82 % chance per seed of failing on a correct run, and a hypothesis prediction was 31 sigma wrong because it was computed for the continuous profile rather than for what the estimator's count floor leaves. Report tol/sigma AND the separation between hypotheses for every observable.
